audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer graded this 8.5/10 and called it a "Hard matchup" while simultaneously tagging diff as EVEN, and both layers describe levels 2 through first item as Aurora's peak. report[2] said "His early — survive to your spikes", which is the opposite of what the chart and prose say.
audit.why: Once the chart matches the packet, Aurora owns five of the seven stages and Olaf owns only the two-item window. An 8.5/10 HARD rating contradicts every other line on the page.
audit.corrected: diffRating 5/10, breakdown.difficulty, report[2] and report[14] brought in line; diff stays EVEN.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and the axe-pickup reset was described without the number it resets.
audit.why: Undertow is a flat 9s at 1000 range and picking the axe up resets it outright; Reckless Swing is 11/10/9/8/7s at 325 range; Tough It Out is 16/15/14/13/12s; Ragnarok is 100/90/80s. Across the Veil at 20s at rank 3 is what you are trading against.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, phases[2].why, phases[3].why and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer states in four places (spikes[3].text, late, whys[6], wants.foe[2]) that Ragnarok adds true damage that ignores shields. It does not. Ragnarok is also described as a blanket CC cleanse with no mention of its actual condition. And the page never mentions Berserker Rage, which is the single most important passive in a poke matchup.
audit.why: Riot's Ragnarok text: "Olaf passively gains increased armor and magic resist. He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking." No true damage, and the immunity is conditional on him continuing to attack — break the attack chain and it lapses, which is exactly what Across the Veil and Between Worlds are for. Olaf's true damage comes from Reckless Swing (E), which also costs him health. Berserker Rage: "Olaf gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health" — so chipping him without killing him actively powers up the duel you are trying to avoid.
audit.corrected: All four true-damage claims re-attributed to Reckless Swing; Ragnarok's "only while he keeps attacking" condition added to breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d; Berserker Rage added to report[5] and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart read Aurora/Skill/Olaf/Olaf/Aurora/Olaf/Olaf, handing Olaf levels 2 through first item — the exact stages both layers call Aurora's takeover.
audit.why: The packet chart, identical on the aurora and olaf packets, is Skill/Aurora/Aurora/Aurora/Aurora/Aurora/Olaf, matching whys[0] ("concede it, last-hit"), whys[1] through whys[5], and whys[6] ("Olaf out-scales hard").
audit.corrected: Five tokens flipped as one atomic group in both layers, with the four contradicting phase whys rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Ragnarok "cleanses your E-slow and the rift slow". I did not verify whether a slow counts as a disable for Ragnarok and left the wording alone.
audit.why: Riot says only "immune to disables" without defining the term, and champ-data/_kits/olaf.json needsResearch is empty, which means unknown rather than no. Undertow also carries a grounding flag that appears nowhere in Riot's description ("dealing damage... reducing their Armor and Move Speed"), so I did not claim the axe grounds Across the Veil.

notes: WIN RATE CONFLICT, not edited: the aurora packet reports 64.86% over 74 games, while the olaf packet reports 51.35% for Olaf over 777 games (implying about 48.65% for Aurora). The two packets disagree and the 777-game sample looks far more trustworthy, which is why I set diffRating to 5/10 rather than something strongly favoured. The packet suspectName "Spirit Abjuration's" in whys[1] is a FALSE POSITIVE — it matches the kit exactly. KIT FLAG MISFIRE worth a champion-level look: Olaf's Undertow carries a "grounding" flag that has no basis in Riot's description, and Aurora's own passive carries an "anti-heal target" flag when the description says it heals HER, while her R carries hardCC when the description lists only damage and slows. Champion-level boilerplate still present: "Between the Worlds" should be "Between Worlds" in phases[4].why and breakdown.late, and "you are a immobile drain bot" is missing "an".
